latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of xlsx skill for advanced spreadsheet creation, editing, and analysis.

- Supports creating, reading, and editing .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, and .tsv files with formulas, formatting, and data visualization.
- Enforces industry-standard Excel conventions for financial models, including color codes, number formats, and formula construction.
- Always preserves existing formatting and formulas when modifying files.
- Requires use of dynamic Excel formulas (not Python-calculated values) to ensure models remain updateable.
- Integrates LibreOffice-based formula recalculation with error detection for zero formula errors in all outputs.
